title: How Did Yang Guifei's Lychees Reach Chang'an?
description:
Yang Guifei wanted fresh lychees. How did Tang relay horses get them to Chang'an? From Du Mu's rider in red dust, we follow Tang relay rules, Bai Juyi's observations of the fruit, and Song debates over origins, the Consort's Orchard and Huaqing Palace visits.

Horse relays are documented. The exact origin, journey time and freshness on arrival remain unresolved. 'Ten stations a day' applied to some demoted officials; 'seven days and seven nights' comes from a Song local gazetteer, not a Tang lychee waybill.

Illustrations are AI-generated, with historical figures shown as cartoon characters. Classical-source checks retain the 2026-10-20 material. This 2026-10-26 rewrite follows new narrative rules; added wording received an independent review. Full sources are in the upload package.
